verdict.rationale: Cline explicitly supports bringing your own API keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others, letting developers choose their model provider, and even lets you configure separate models for Plan vs Act modes. Community evidence corroborates using different providers (e.g., Gemini 2.5, local Ollama models) interchangeably. Missing for 10: no first-party evidence of a full in-app provider selection UI walkthrough or pricing comparison across providers.
